name: DREAMS TAKE OVER
author: wokecat
description: Skip the yellow orb inside the gravity portal at 23% and then fly between the lower saw and spike and then do a small hold to make it above the second spike while avoiding the cube portal at 24%. Go above the level at 26% between the slopes and stay above the gameplay but below the clouds and continue like that. Click the red orb at 52% and then hold until you can see that your icon is above the structures. Stay slightly above the gameplay for the rest of the level from there.
